headline: US Dollar Index eases to 103.86 as Treasury yield decline snaps winning streak
summary: The US Dollar Index fell 0.1% to 103.86, pausing after an eight-session rally. Lower US Treasury bond yields weighed on the currency, boosting the Japanese yen despite lingering risk aversion.
why: The US dollar is the dominant global reserve currency. Its foreign exchange movements impact multinational revenues, trade balances, and international capital flows.
